purpose: Outcome-blind source, timestamp, missingness, and eligibility audit before endpoint computation

candidates.series: England and Wales Precipitation monthly totals
candidates.sentinel_policy: Treat -99.9 as missing, never as a measurement

candidates.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED

required_controls: Acquire the exact raw source file without running the endpoint estimator
Record UTC retrieval time and source vintage
Calculate and record SHA-256 of the unmodified raw file before parsing
Preserve the raw file and record its exact repository or artifact location
Audit timestamp order, duplicate timestamps, missing periods, cadence, and source-specific sentinels
Do not interpolate missing observations silently
Record parsed-data hash separately from raw-file hash
Verify minimum length and frequency-resolution requirements without computing endpoint values
Complete independent shared-nuisance and domain-independence review
Keep every unverified field UNKNOWN or PENDING rather than converting it to NO or PASS
Do not compute candidate endpoints until the complete confirmatory protocol is approved and frozen
